text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. Thank you for your consideration of this matter. These appointments are a result of the following public member's terms coming to an end: - Jennifer King, term ending June 30, 2025 and until a successor is appointed.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Gillian Grant to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 30, 2027 and until a successor is appointed. 2. Re-appointed the following members to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office ending June 30, 2027 and until successors are appointed: - Rebecca Heersink - Abas Barra - Rob MacKinnon - Andrea Nameth - Courtney Fitton
